items.label: Façade sud & porche
items.prompt: Eye-level 16:9 architectural visualization of the contemporary single-story tropical villa featuring a 100% flat roof with parapet walls, off-white stucco facade, prominent entrance porch with two square pillars supporting a flat concrete canopy, dark wood door, anthracite aluminum windows, interlocking paver walkway, lush tropical landscaping (coconut palms, bougainvillea, bird-of-paradise, alocasia), and late afternoon golden-hour illumination with an elegantly dressed couple in the garden.
items.notes: Toit plat avec acrotère, porche à colonnes, jardin tropical et personnages d'échelle

items.label: Séjour
items.prompt: Ultra-realistic high-end archviz photograph (16:9) of the contemporary villa's living room featuring a U-shaped arrangement of three beige linen sofas, a low oak coffee table on a cream textured wool rug, an east-wall mounted TV above a floating wood credenza, wide-plank light oak parquet flooring, a modern matte-black designer chandelier, and floor-to-ceiling anthracite windows opening out onto a sunny covered porch and lush tropical garden.
items.notes: Parquet chêne clair, canapés lin beige en U, meuble TV, vue sur le porche et jardin

items.label: Vue aérienne
items.prompt: An aerial three-quarter drone view (16:9, ~12m altitude) of a contemporary luxury single-story villa with a 100% flat roof and dark perimeter acroterion, crisp off-white stucco walls, anthracite double-casement windows, a two-column flat-slab entrance porch, a wooden-slat pergola terrace, and grey paved pathways set within a walled tropical garden overflowing with vibrant pink bougainvillea, mature coconut palms, and alocasias under bright morning sunlight.
items.notes: Vue drone trois-quarts sud-ouest, toiture plate avec acrotère, jardin tropical et clôture

items.label: Plan masse 2D coloré
items.prompt: High-end top-down 2D architectural presentation master plan rendering (orthographic cut at 1.2m height) of a contemporary single-story tropical villa (~11.5m x 11.5m footprint) featuring crisp dark poché cut walls, warm light oak parquet, a U-shaped living room arrangement, 8-seater dining room, modern tiled kitchen leading to a pergola service terrace, master suite with dressing wardrobe, two guest bedrooms, ceramic tiled bathrooms, a south entrance porch with two white square columns, and lush surrounding tropical landscaping (coconut palm crowns, flowering bougainvillea hedges, lawn, and interlocking paver driveway).
items.notes: Plan masse de présentation avec matériaux réalistes et aménagement paysager tropical

items.label: Séjour — photoréaliste
items.prompt: Photorealistically re-render the attached architectural image. Preserve the exact camera framing, geometry, wall locations, openings, and every furniture item: do not add, remove, move, or redesign anything. Improve only material realism, physically plausible textures, natural global illumination, shadows, and reflections. For interiors keep the same room layout and furnishings; for exterior views keep the existing tropical context. High-end architectural visualization, realistic but strictly faithful to the source image.
items.notes: Image issue du rendu Three.js ; géométrie à vérifier visuellement.

items.label: Arrivée porche & façade
items.prompt: Cinematic slow push-in shot along the paved walkway towards the modern tropical villa entrance porch. Golden hour sunlight, subtle breeze in the palm trees and bougainvillea, rock-solid architectural geometry, 4K archviz.
items.movement: Travelling avant lent vers le porche

items.label: Visite panoramique du séjour
items.prompt: Slow, steady cinematic interior pan across luxury contemporary living room. Warm natural daylight through floor-to-ceiling glass, subtle reflections on light oak parquet, perfectly stable walls and furniture.
items.movement: Panoramique horizontal lent de gauche à droite
